abstract:
PointWorld: Scaling 3D World Models for In-The-Wild Robotic Manipulation

PointWorld Training and Evaluation Pipeline for "PointWorld: Scaling 3D World Models for In-The-Wild Robotic Manipulation". Wenlong Huang 1,† , Yu-Wei Chao 2 , Arsalan Mousavian 2 , Ming-Yu Liu 2 , Dieter Fox 2 , Kaichun Mo 2,* , Li Fei-Fei 1,* 1 Stanford University, 2 NVIDIA * Equal advising  |  † Work done partly at NVIDIA PointWorld is a large pre-trained 3D world model that predicts full-scene 3D point flows from partially observable RGB-D captures and robot actions, also represented as 3D point flows. If you find this work useful in your research, please cite using the following BibTeX: ## 🗂️ Table of Contents - [Important Notes](#important-notes) - [Setup](#setup) - [Datasets And Checkpoints](#datasets-and-checkpoints) - [Training](#training) - [Evaluation](#evaluation) - [Visualization](#visualization) - [Known Limitations](#known-limitations) - [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements) - [Contributing](#contributing) ## 📌 Important Notes - Released datasets and pretrained checkpoints are hosted on Hugging Face: - DROID generated H5 package: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PointWorld-DROID - BEHAVIOR generated H5 package: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PointWorld-BEHAVIOR - pretrained PointWorld checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/nvidia/PointWorld_models - `main` is the training/evaluation code branch for release. - `data` is the dataset preparation pipeline branch. - Please first prepare the data using the `data` branch. Then return to `main` for training and evaluation. ## 🛠️ Setup ### Environment The `main` branch provides a self-contained conda setup with no local editable dependencies. Recommended baseline for reproducibility in `main`: - Linux `x86_64` - Python `3.10` - NVIDIA driver compatible with CUDA 12.4 wheels Recommended setup: If you also need visualization extras: Dependency layout: - `environments/requirements.txt`: canonical base dependency list for train/eval. - `environments/train_eval_viz.yml`: optional visualization

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：PointWorld 是一个大规模预训练的 3D 世界模型：以部分可观测的 RGB-D 观测和机器人动作（同样表示为 3D 点流）为输入，预测整场景（full-scene）的 3D 点流，作为对场景未来几何运动的统一表征。


# 一、动机

> 现有机器人操作的世界模型多局限于 2D 视频预测或物体级状态，难以在真实、非受限（in-the-wild）场景下对整场景三维几何演化进行建模；本文希望用可扩展的大规模 3D 世界模型补齐这一空白。


# 二、方法

> PointWorld 是一个大规模预训练的 3D 世界模型：以部分可观测的 RGB-D 观测和机器人动作（同样表示为 3D 点流）为输入，预测整场景（full-scene）的 3D 点流，作为对场景未来几何运动的统一表征。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 论文在 DROID 与 BEHAVIOR 两个大规模数据集上完成预训练，并开源了对应的 H5 数据包（nvidia/PointWorld-DROID、nvidia/PointWorld-BEHAVIOR）与预训练权重（nvidia/PointWorld_models）；代码分为 data 分支（数据准备）与 main 分支（训练/评估）两套流程。摘要未给出定量指标，具体数值需阅读正文。


# 四、对我的启发

> 以点流（point flow）统一表示动作与场景几何，思路对具身智能中的跨本体运动建模与动作条件世界模型有参考价值；但目前仅提供数据与权重，未在摘要中报告成功率等量化结果，且作者列出了 Known Limitations（如部分可观测、场景规模等），实际可用性需进一步验证。与具身智能/机器人操作课题高度相关。
